knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The documented requirements and the product label are the basis for choosing an ingredient or product, not a natural or eco claim on its own.
The lesson says to check that all three refer to the same product, formulation and version, and to note their dates.

practicalCriteria: Learner obtains the label, SDS and full composition for a supplied product and confirms all three are on file before evaluating it.
Learner lists each ingredient with its function and identifies any hazard statement or surface guidance that applies.
Learner decides use, use with controls or refer for the product and records the reason and the sources.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Ingredient evaluation record with sources, decision and review date
stopWorkCriteria: Learner approves a product with no SDS or no composition on file
Learner approves a product because its ingredients are familiar or it is marketed as natural
